# Overview

This document reports the content validity analysis of the AI Literacy scale
adapted for Chilean university students, based on Han & Zhang (2025).

Content validity was assessed through expert judgment using **Aiken's V coefficient**
(Aiken, 1985), which quantifies the degree of agreement among judges regarding
two dimensions of each item: **relevance** and **wording**.

**Scale:** 4-point rating scale (1 = strongly disagree, 4 = strongly agree)  
**Threshold:** V ≥ .80 acceptable for Q1 publication (Aiken, 1985; Merino-Soto & Livia-Segovia, 2009)  
**Confidence interval:** 95% (Penfield & Giacobbi, 2004)  

**Key methodological references:**

- Aiken, L. R. (1985). Three coefficients for analyzing the reliability and
  validity of ratings. *Educational and Psychological Measurement, 45*(1), 131–142.
- Merino-Soto, C., & Livia-Segovia, J. (2009). Intervalos de confianza asimétricos
  para el índice V de Aiken. *Psicothema, 21*(4), 659–664.
- Penfield, R. D., & Giacobbi, P. R. (2004). Applying a score confidence interval
  to Aiken's item content-relevance index. *Measurement in Physical Education and
  Exercise Science, 8*(4), 213–225.

# Step 3 — Aiken's V Computation

```{r aiken-functions}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Aiken's V coefficient
# Formula: V = sum(s) / (N * (k-1))
# where s = rating - 1, N = number of raters, k = number of scale categories
# Reference: Aiken (1985)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_aiken_v <- function(ratings, k) {
  N <- length(ratings)
  V <- sum(ratings - 1) / (N * (k - 1))
  return(V)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 95% Confidence interval for Aiken's V
# Uses the asymmetric CI formula from Penfield & Giacobbi (2004)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_aiken_ci <- function(V, n, k, confidence = 0.95) {
  z          <- qnorm(1 - (1 - confidence) / 2)
  sqrt_term  <- sqrt(4 * n * k * V * (1 - V) + z^2)
  lower      <- (2 * n * k * V + z^2 - z * sqrt_term) / (2 * (n * k + z^2))
  upper      <- (2 * n * k * V + z^2 + z * sqrt_term) / (2 * (n * k + z^2))
  return(c(lower, upper))
}
```

```{r aiken-compute}
# Reshape to long format for item-level analysis
lf2 <- df2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -dimension,
               names_to  = "item",
               values_to = "valor")

# Scale parameters
k          <- 4      # Number of response categories (4-point scale)
confidence <- 0.95   # Confidence level for CI

# Compute Aiken's V, mean rating, and 95% CI per item and dimension
results <- lf2 %>%
  group_by(dimension, item) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(valor),
    V           = compute_aiken_v(valor, k),
    n           = length(valor),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    CI_lower = compute_aiken_ci(V, n, k, confidence)[1],
    CI_upper = compute_aiken_ci(V, n, k, confidence)[2]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Compute score frequency counts (1 to 4) per item
frequencies <- lf2 %>%
  group_by(dimension, item, valor) %>%
  summarise(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = valor,
              values_from = freq,
              values_fill = list(freq = 0))

# Merge results with frequencies
results_full <- results %>%
  left_join(frequencies, by = c("dimension", "item")) %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(as.character(1:4)), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

# Reorder columns: frequencies, mean, V, CI
results_full <- results_full %>%
  dplyr::select(dimension, item,
                any_of(as.character(1:4)),
                mean_rating, V, CI_lower, CI_upper) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_rating, V, CI_lower, CI_upper), ~round(.x, 3)))

cat(sprintf("Items computed: %d (across %d dimensions)\n",
            nrow(results_full),
            length(unique(results_full$dimension))))

# Flag items below the V >= .80 threshold
items_below <- results_full %>%
  filter(V < .80) %>%
  dplyr::select(dimension, item, V, CI_lower, CI_upper)

if (nrow(items_below) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nItems with V < .80 (n = %d):\n", nrow(items_below)))
  print(items_below, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("\nAll items meet the V >= .80 threshold.\n")
}
```

---

# Step 4 — Results by Dimension

## 4a. Relevance

```{r table-relevance}
# Filter and display relevance dimension results
tabla_relevance <- results_full %>%
  filter(dimension == "relevance") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dimension)

kable(tabla_relevance,
      caption = "Table 2. Content validity analysis — Relevance (Aiken's V, 95% CI)",
      col.names = c("Item", "1", "2", "3", "4",
                    "Mean", "V", "CI lower", "CI upper"),
      align = "lrrrrrrrrr",
      digits = 3)

# Summary statistics for relevance
cat(sprintf("\nRelevance — Summary:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  V range:  %.3f – %.3f\n",
            min(tabla_relevance$V), max(tabla_relevance$V)))
cat(sprintf("  V mean:   %.3f\n", mean(tabla_relevance$V)))
cat(sprintf("  Items V >= .80: %d / %d (%.0f%%)\n",
            sum(tabla_relevance$V >= .80), nrow(tabla_relevance),
            100 * mean(tabla_relevance$V >= .80)))
```

## 4b. Wording

```{r table-wording}
# Filter and display wording dimension results
tabla_wording <- results_full %>%
  filter(dimension == "wording") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dimension)

kable(tabla_wording,
      caption = "Table 3. Content validity analysis — Wording (Aiken's V, 95% CI)",
      col.names = c("Item", "1", "2", "3", "4",
                    "Mean", "V", "CI lower", "CI upper"),
      align = "lrrrrrrrrr",
      digits = 3)

# Summary statistics for wording
cat(sprintf("\nWording — Summary:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  V range:  %.3f – %.3f\n",
            min(tabla_wording$V), max(tabla_wording$V)))
cat(sprintf("  V mean:   %.3f\n", mean(tabla_wording$V)))
cat(sprintf("  Items V >= .80: %d / %d (%.0f%%)\n",
            sum(tabla_wording$V >= .80), nrow(tabla_wording),
            100 * mean(tabla_wording$V >= .80)))
```

## 4c. Combined Summary

```{r summary-combined}
# Overall summary across both dimensions
summary_overall <- results_full %>%
  group_by(dimension) %>%
  summarise(
    n_items      = n(),
    V_mean       = round(mean(V), 3),
    V_min        = round(min(V), 3),
    V_max        = round(max(V), 3),
    n_above_80   = sum(V >= .80),
    pct_above_80 = round(100 * mean(V >= .80), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(summary_overall,
      caption = "Table 4. Summary of Aiken's V by dimension",
      col.names = c("Dimension", "N items", "V mean",
                    "V min", "V max", "n V≥.80", "% V≥.80"),
      align = "lrrrrrr")
```

# Step 5 — Visualizations

## 5. Visualization — Publication-ready figure

```{r plot-aiken-final, fig.width=7.09, fig.height=8.66, dpi=300, fig.cap="Aiken's V with 95% CI by subscale and dimension. Green dashed line = .80 threshold (Aiken, 1985); dotted red line = .50 minimum for CI lower bound; bars = 95% CI (Penfield & Giacobbi, 2004). × = item below threshold."}

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clr_rel   <- "#185FA5"
clr_wor   <- "#0F6E56"
clr_below <- "#A32D2D"
clr_v80   <- "#3B6D11"
clr_v50   <- "#A32D2D"

# ── Theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_aiken <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
    theme(
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),  # (3) no fill, black frame only
      strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8.5),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7.5),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7.5),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 8.5, margin = margin(t = 6)),
      axis.title.y       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#D3D1C7", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.spacing      = unit(0.4, "lines"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size    = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "grey40"),
      plot.caption       = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey50", hjust = 0)
    )
}

# ── Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- results %>%
  mutate(
    subscale        = factor(str_extract(item, "^[A-Z]+")),
    meets_threshold = V >= .80,
    color_group     = if_else(meets_threshold, dimension, "below"),
    # (4) CI lower bound cannot be smaller than .50
    CI_lower        = pmax(CI_lower, 0.50)
  )

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_final <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = V, y = fct_rev(factor(item)), color = color_group, shape = meets_threshold)
) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper),
    height = 0.45, linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.80, color = clr_v80,
             linetype = "dashed",  linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.50, color = clr_v50,
             linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.55, alpha = 0.6) +
  # (1) V value in parentheses
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("(%.2f)", V), x = CI_upper + 0.01),
    hjust = 0, size = 1.9, color = "grey30"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(relevance = clr_rel, wording = clr_wor, below = clr_below),
    labels = c(relevance = "Relevance (V ≥ .80)",
               wording   = "Wording (V ≥ .80)",
               below     = "Below threshold (V < .80)"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 4), guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(
    subscale ~ dimension,
    scales   = "free_y",
    space    = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(dimension = c(relevance = "Relevance", wording = "Wording"))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.35, 1.08),
    breaks = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0),
    labels = c(".50", ".60", ".70", ".80", ".90", "1.00")
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Aiken's V (point estimate with 95% CI)",
#    title    = "Content Validity — Aiken's V by Subscale and Dimension",
#    subtitle = "Dashed = .80 threshold · Dotted = .50 minimum for CI lower bound · Bars = 95% CI",
    # (2) 14 judges
#    caption  = "× = item below threshold; ● = item meeting threshold. n = 14 judges, k = 4 categories."
  ) +
  theme_aiken()

p_final

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("fig_aiken_v_content_validity.tiff",
       plot = p_final, width = 18, height = 22,
       units = "cm", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")

ggsave("fig_aiken_v_content_validity.pdf",
       plot = p_final, width = 18, height = 22,
       units = "cm", device = cairo_pdf)
```
---

# Step 6 — Items Below Threshold

```{r below-threshold}
# Identify items that do not meet the V >= .80 criterion
# These items were candidates for revision or elimination before EFA
items_low_v <- results_full %>%
  filter(V < .80) %>%
  arrange(dimension, V) %>%
  dplyr::select(dimension, item, V, CI_lower, CI_upper, mean_rating)

if (nrow(items_low_v) > 0) {
  kable(items_low_v,
        caption = "Items with Aiken's V < .80 — candidates for revision",
        col.names = c("Dimension", "Item", "V",
                      "CI lower", "CI upper", "Mean rating"),
        digits = 3,
        row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("\nTotal items below threshold: %d\n", nrow(items_low_v)))
  cat("These items were reviewed qualitatively based on expert comments\n")
  cat("prior to the exploratory factor analysis (EFA).\n")
} else {
  cat("All items met the V >= .80 criterion in both dimensions.\n")
  cat("No items required revision based on content validity results.\n")
}
```

# Step 7 — Export Results to Excel

```{r export}
library(openxlsx)

wb_cv <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Full results
addWorksheet(wb_cv, "Aiken_V_Full")
writeData(wb_cv, "Aiken_V_Full", results_full)

# Sheet 2: Relevance only
addWorksheet(wb_cv, "Relevance")
writeData(wb_cv, "Relevance", tabla_relevance)

# Sheet 3: Wording only
addWorksheet(wb_cv, "Wording")
writeData(wb_cv, "Wording", tabla_wording)

# Sheet 4: Summary
addWorksheet(wb_cv, "Summary")
writeData(wb_cv, "Summary", summary_overall)

# Sheet 5: Items below threshold (if any)
if (nrow(items_low_v) > 0) {
  addWorksheet(wb_cv, "Items_below_threshold")
  writeData(wb_cv, "Items_below_threshold", items_low_v)
}

saveWorkbook(wb_cv, "resultados_validacion_contenido.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Results exported: resultados_validacion_contenido.xlsx\n")
```
